## TRA Timeline

#### Pre-IPO drafting

- 2024-08-26: Initial form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.1 to S-1/A
- 2025-05-20: Revised form-of TRA filed with S-1/A; adds Section 2.09 (Relative Fair Market Value Determinations); otherwise identical contract structure

#### IPO and TRA execution

- 2026-04-02: Executed TRA dated as of IPO close, 85% of net cash tax savings to Baker Hughes Holdings, Akastor AS, Mercury HoldCo AS, and Mercury HoldCo Inc.; filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the IPO close 8-K

## Explanation

HMH Holding Inc. executed its Tax Receivable Agreement at the April 2, 2026 IPO, committing to pay the Principal Stockholders (Baker Hughes Holdings LLC and the Akastor/Mercury HoldCo group) 85% of the cash tax savings from three asset categories: basis step-ups on the public company's acquisitions of HMH Holding B.V. Non-Voting Shares and Mercury US shares, utilization of Mercury HoldCo Inc.'s pre-IPO U.S. net operating losses on a Hybrid Redemption, and imputed interest and additional basis arising from TRA payments. The structure is Up-C-like but uses a Netherlands B.V. as the operating vehicle in place of a Delaware LLC; mechanics, payment percentage, and termination provisions otherwise track the standard pattern. The TRA is in force as of the post-IPO 8-K with no amendments or material events yet on file. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
